description: This file defines the 'initMySugar' function, which initializes the 'MySugar' object containing various methods for managing dashboard dashlets in the SuiteCRM application. The methods include functions for retrieving, adding, deleting, configuring dashlets, managing layouts, and handling dialog interfaces within the dashboard UI.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the current dashboard layout as a string or array based on the argument.

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: Handles actions when a dashlet is picked up for dragging.

methods.name: onDrop
methods.description: Handles actions when a dashlet is dropped, including layout saving and chart reloading.

methods.name: saveLayout
methods.description: Saves the current dashlet layout via AJAX request to the backend.

methods.name: uncoverPage
methods.description: Closes the dashlet configuration dialog.

methods.name: configureDashlet
methods.description: Opens the configuration dialog for a specific dashlet.

methods.name: retrieveDashlet
methods.description: Fetches and updates the content for a specified dashlet, with support for dynamic content.

methods.name: setChooser
methods.description: Sets the display and hide column options for dashboard components.

methods.name: deleteDashlet
methods.description: Deletes a dashlet after confirmation, with UI animation.

methods.name: addDashlet
methods.description: Adds a new dashlet to the dashboard, including layout updates and content loading.

methods.name: retrieveCurrentPage
methods.description: Loads the current page of the dashboard.

methods.name: showDashletsDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to add dashlets to the dashboard.

methods.name: closeDashletsDialog
methods.description: Closes the dashlets selection dialog.

methods.name: toggleDashletCategories
methods.description: Switches between different dashlet categories for browsing.

methods.name: searchDashlets
methods.description: Performs a search within dashlets based on input string and category.

methods.name: collapseList
methods.description: Collapses a list section in the dashboard UI.

methods.name: expandList
methods.description: Expands a list section in the dashboard UI.

methods.name: collapseReportList
methods.description: Collapses a report list in the UI.

methods.name: expandReportList
methods.description: Expands a report list in the UI.

methods.name: clearSearch
methods.description: Clears the dashlet search input and resets category display.

methods.name: doneAddDashlets
methods.description: Handles completion of adding dashlets.

methods.name: refreshPageForAnalytics
methods.description: Reloads the page, possibly to refresh analytics data.

methods.name: renderDashletsDialog
methods.description: Initializes and renders the dashlets selection dialog box.
